steps.text: 6:44 P.M. \ Clear
Lungmen Ring Expressway, Car

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master, are you asleep?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hm, oh... Where are we?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: We will soon arrive at the rendezvous point. Do clear your head, Young Master. Penguin Logistics is already there waiting for you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mm. Right.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: You seem exhausted.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Forgive my indiscretion, Sir, but you do seem to have made this decision in some haste. You know of course that you may at any time share any matters that trouble you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...My father... he definitely has his own ideas.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But all I have to do is get Penguin Logistics on board. Then those guys won't be able to get between me and my father ever again.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: You are the youngest Messenger in the history of your family, Young Master. You perform all of your duties impeccably. Surely that will be enough.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Maybe. But who knows if they'll feel the same way.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Looking out at the city, all I can think about is how almost all of Lungmen's Messenger firms belong to my father.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is the last. And the most independent. And the one with a ton of weird rumors swirling around it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: My father gets along pretty well with Mr. Emperor, but we have to do more to really get them. Or at least I do.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: That is why I worry, Young Master. I am well aware Penguin Logistics is a most peculiar organization.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Don't look at me like that. I got this.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: You might change your expression as well, Young Master. Perhaps if you smiled more, like the boys your age.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: It's Sauin tonight. You could go out on the town with your friends.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...real funny. Me not having friends is a joke to you, huh?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Heavens no! Perish the thought! Haha.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Dreadfully sorry, Young Master. Do you have your shield with you?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: I'm afraid we're being watched.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Target sighted. You ready?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Gah, this fuse is still all...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Just do it already.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Nng... an explosion?!

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Hold on, Young Master!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Target sighted. He's still up.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Bring him in. Quick.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (They bombed out the road...? But who...?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Shit... my vision's... all blurry...)

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Report.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Lots of witnesses, but I don't see the other targets.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Hold up, there's somebody in the smoke there!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Another survivor? You gotta-

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Nnng...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hey? Hey!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You got whacked that easy?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Talk about a hackneyed mob movie plot,

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Penguin Logistics.
Ooh, sounds like you passed Screenwriting 101.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But like, throwing up a roadblock on a suburban highway and burying a bomb on the side there. Isn't that also really cliche?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Demolition's just a hobby of mine. Take a look around and I think you'll find things ain't so simple.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Damn. How much Originium did that mook use in his bomb? The Rat King'll have our balls for breakfast if he finds out.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: We found a Penguin Logistics Messenger. It's Exusiai. Looks like she bumped off the wrecking crew...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Do I look blind to you? Where's the wolf? Texas?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Dunno. Don't see her.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Fuggedaboutit. Surround 'em. Let's get this done.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: An ambush, huh? They're nothing if not thorough.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, can you move? Your limbs are all shaky.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Yeah, kinda... You must be... Exusiai?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's me! And you're... uh... Whatsisname!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Bison.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We... we should get out of here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Before you get all mopey, that old butlery guy is a-okay.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I put him by the roadside for a minute, but he doesn't look like he needs much help... anyway!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Exusiai, Messenger of Penguin Logistics, and the little rich kid there, give it up. Come with us nice and easy-like.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: All these fresh faces, must be your relatives from Siracusa? Didn't you teach them how things work in Lungmen?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: None of your damned business. We're cleaning you out for good this time.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh come on... You've been in Lungmen so long you turned basic. Grabbing territory like a common thug.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I guess at least some of the Siracusan Mafia can do more than just bar brawls.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Grr... I'll teach you to look down on a Sicilian. *Lungmen Swearing* Get 'em!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Awright, looks like I'm right on time!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Croissant, you made it!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But they're all so ornery. What're we gonna do?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The usual. You clear a path, I'll bring up the rear, we split the completion bonus.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Now that's all ya had to say! Yeeehawww!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Th- that crazy broad charged right through!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...get after them. But not too close. Wait for backup.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You lost 'em, cazzo.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Look, I ain't a kidnapping expert. The rest of Penguin Logistics never showed and we weren't about to go traipsing into downtown Lungmen by ourselves.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I don't wanna hear excuses. There's a car headed your way. Convertible. Old friends inside.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...already?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Gah, damn it. Another dead end?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It's a buncha old ruins nobody's touched fer ages. Lemme just make my own hole already.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: H- hold up! Where are we going?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: There they are! It's a dead end! We got 'em!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's game over, isn't it?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh yeah!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You have an idea?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We haven't properly introduced ourselves, have we?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Rub 'em out!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Now's not the time for this! We've got more important things to deal with!
Nah.
This is important. Real important.
We got a serious emphasis on corporate culture. And today's culture buzzword is 'courtesy.'

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I just came up with it.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: It's Emperor! Somebody call the boss!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: There's someone else with him!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Came up empty, Exusiai.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Not every Siracusan mook's a total moron. We'll get 'em next time, don't worry.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But first, I've got to introduce you to Penguin Logistics's newest temp worker: Bison.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: They blocked the only way out. We- we have to fight through!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Get down on the ground. You don't have to die.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Woah! Settle down, we just have to hold out until the boss...!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hold out?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hit the lights.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Agh! It's so bright! Where'd that spotlight come from?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Welcome to Penguin Logistics, little doggies.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Now I can see you. And that means you're on land that belongs to the Penguin Empire.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Now I hate to bother you, but I'm gonna have to see your landing visa. You got it on you?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: No?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Then I think we gotta send you crying home to your mamas.
